_note: Written BEFORE any reader saw a line (row IC, Session 4, the final reading). `pairs` is the approved plan's question 1 (two lines, two named marshals: which said which); `sixway` the harder test besides (IC4-R1).

pairs.line1: I kept the enemy watched today, Sire. I know more than I did.
pairs.line2: Still nothing to fight, Sire. The men are restless, and so am I.

pairs.line1: They beat us off, Sire. I'll be more careful — for now.
pairs.line2: A loss. I'm keeping closer to my lines.
It's done, Sire. Without much loss, I'm glad to say.

pairs.line1: On the road, Sire. Nothing I own is left open behind me.
pairs.line2: Hard marching today, Sire. I want to be close when the guns begin.

pairs.line1: Right, Sire. If the guns speak, I'll be there.
pairs.line2: Understood. I'll not waste a man.

pairs.line1: Right, Sire. If the guns speak, I'll be there.
pairs.line2: Understood. No need to hurry me.

pairs.line1: A bad day for the cavalry. It makes me think twice.
pairs.line2: A loss. I'm keeping closer to my lines.

pairs.line1: Not a third night of the same, Sire. I'll hold my ground another way.
pairs.line2: Even I can't do the same thing three nights, Sire. I've changed it.

pairs.line1: No guns near me yet, Sire.
pairs.line2: I see dust on the roads and none of it worth following.

pairs.line1: You call me back, Sire? I was just getting started.
pairs.line2: I return the task to you, Sire. Gladly.

pairs.line1: Done, Sire. Point me at the next one and I'll ride.
pairs.line2: The task is complete, Sire. The corps is intact.

pairs.line1: Tell me where to ride, Sire.
pairs.line2: Tell me what to hit, Sire, and I'll go.

rows.line: We fought today, Sire. I've been itching for it.
Every man was in place, so I sent them in, Sire.
I led the columns in myself, Sire. That's all.
There was fighting today, Sire. I'm sure you understand I took what care I could.
They came too near my ground, so I hit them.
The cavalry was in it today, Sire. You could hear us coming.
Marching toward the sound of it, Sire.
On the road, Sire. We'll be up with them soon.
Riding hard, Sire. We gain on them every hour.
A march nearer. I leave nothing loose behind me.
Moving up, Sire. Every wagon is closed up and every man accounted for.
Some progress today. More tomorrow, I expect.
Understood. I'll not waste a man.
Done. Where the guns are, I'll be.
At last, Sire! Leave it to me.
A task for a cavalryman, Sire! I'll ride it in style.
Leave it with me, Sire. Once I have it in hand, I keep it.
Understood. No need to hurry me.
Done, Sire. Point me at the next one and I'll ride.
Done, Sire. I've lost nothing doing it.
Done, Sire, and no fuss about it. Now where are the guns?
Finished, Sire. Nothing wasted, nothing missing, and the rolls are right.
It's done, Sire. Without much loss, I'm glad to say.
Finished, Sire. Find me another fight.
I waited for a clearer picture, Sire. One can hardly be blamed.
No assault today. I'll tell you straight when there's one worth making.
I stayed where I was. Tomorrow I fight, Sire.
I kept the horses in. Even I can do that, once.
No move today, Sire. Things changed, and my figures no longer held.
No move today. Here I know what I have.
